mapper.sql: id, content_type, content_key, poi_id, content_text, audit_status, enabled, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from roam_ai_content where content_type = 'POI_MEANING' and poi_id = #{poiId} and audit_status = 1 and enabled = 1 limit 1
select from roam_ai_content where content_type = 'ROUTE_STORY' and audit_status = 1 and enabled = 1 order by content_key asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into roam_ai_content (content_type, content_key, poi_id, content_text, audit_status, enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{contentType}, #{contentKey}, #{poiId}, #{contentText}, #{auditStatus}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update roam_ai_content set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
